styles.name: Storm grey waist apron with wide pocket and centre stitch divide, black non tangle ties — GBK, no logo
styles.desc: WAIST APRON · Wide pocket 40 cm x 23 cm with centre stitch divide, set centrally · Black non tangle waist ties · No triangle stitch on the pocket: bartacked · No logo
fabrics: Storm grey 6 oz 65% recycled polyester / 35% BCI cotton 200 gsm (Tiajo) — rating 0.50 m
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S STORM GREY 09963 — cost per metre

Tibard printed care label, set to the right side seam as worn, 4 cm down from the finished top edge: 65% recycled polyester / 35% BCI cotton · 60° wash · no bleach · 2 dot iron · tumble dry · P dry clean. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
Black non tangle tape, cut 100 cm, two per apron. Sage holds black non tangle tape only as the OH-branded CMP-OH-NTT-25-03: use that code if it is the same tape.
mfg: Double turn hem and waist and topstitch 12 mm.
Double turn side seams and topstitch 12 mm. Insert waist ties to finish level with the top edge. Insert labels in the right side seam.
Double stitch waist ties to secure.
Set hem to pocket: double turned and topstitched 1 cm.
Edgestitch pocket to front. Pocket set centrally to width, top of pocket 10 cm down from the finished top edge.
Bartack the top of the pocket and the centre stitch divide: 3 bartacks in total. No triangle stitch on the pocket.
fin: Check, trim and fold. Set into a polybag with the sticker in the bottom right-hand corner of the bag.
styles.note: Works order GBKAPP064464 (JH 22/3/16 for SR596; JH 10/9/18 SR713, approved for bulk 5/11/18; polybag and label added JH 12/11/18; eco fabric, supplier and code YL 31/10/24). No logo. The sheet's sketch of the apron is in works-orders/GBKAPP064464-GBK.xlsx.
